description:
As a Staff DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical leadership role in GE Vernova Grid Software's mission of enabling a more sustainable, reliable, and resilient energy future by defining and executing the DevOps strategy across the Transmission portfolio, spanning both heritage products and GridOS-based solutions. You will drive the transformation of software delivery practices, modernize build and release ecosystems, establish enterprise-scale CI/CD standards, and accelerate engineering productivity through automation, cloud-native platforms, and DevSecOps practices.
  
  
Leveraging deep expertise in DevOps, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, automation, release engineering, observability, and platform engineering, you will lead the design and implementation of scalable engineering systems that enable reliable, secure, and predictable software delivery across a diverse product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, product teams, cybersecurity teams, and infrastructure organizations to establish common DevOps frameworks, deployment standards, and operational excellence practices.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong technical leadership, hands-on implementation experience, and a proven track record of driving large-scale DevOps transformations across complex enterprise software environments.

**Job Description**
===================

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and own the **DevOps vision, strategy, roadmap, and implementation** across the Transmission Software portfolio, including both heritage EMS/SCADA products and GridOS-native applications.
* Lead the standardization and modernization of CI/CD platforms, build systems, release pipelines, artifact management, and deployment automation across multiple product lines.
* Drive adoption of **DevSecOps practices**, integrating security scanning, compliance checks, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement into engineering workflows.
* Establish enterprise-wide standards for source control, branching models, automated testing, release governance, environment management, and deployment processes.
* Partner with engineering teams to enable cloud-native development practices leveraging containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and platform engineering principles.
* Design and implement scalable automation frameworks that improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, and accelerate software delivery cycles.
* Lead modernization initiatives to transition legacy build, deployment, and release processes toward highly automated and self-service platforms.
* Partner with product engineering and quality organizations to achieve best-in-class automation coverage, deployment reliability, release quality, and operational readiness.
* Define and track key DevOps metrics, including deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR, pipeline efficiency, and engineering productivity.
* Drive implementation of observability solutions including logging, monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational dashboards across portfolio products.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and platform teams to ensure highly available, secure, and scalable engineering environments.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, implementation guidance, mentoring, and coaching of DevOps engineers and development teams.
* Champion Agile, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Platform Engineering best practices throughout the organization.
* Partner with global engineering teams to improve release predictability, deployment consistency, operational excellence, and customer delivery outcomes.
* Drive portfolio-wide initiatives to reduce technical debt, improve developer experience, and establish a modern software delivery ecosystem.

**Desired Characteristics**
---------------------------

* Deep expertise in DevOps, CI/CD, Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Software Delivery at enterprise scale.
* Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD platforms using technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar frameworks.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, or GCP, and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, container orchestration, and platform automation.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent.

* Experience building enterprise-scale deployment automation and release management processes supporting multiple global development teams.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps, application security, compliance automation, vulnerability management, and secure software delivery practices.
* Expertise in observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting both legacy enterprise applications and modern microservices-based architectures.
* Strong understanding of software quality engineering, automated testing strategies, test orchestration, and quality gates.
* Knowledge of power systems, transmission operations, EMS, SCADA, GridOS, utility software, or industrial control systems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering organizations, drive transformation initiatives, and build consensus across multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and organizational change management skills.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or related STEM discipline.
* **10+ years** of experience in Software Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Platform Engineering, Release Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure.
* Minimum **5+ years of experience leading DevOps transformation initiatives** across enterprise software organizations.
* Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, cloud technologies, automation tooling, infrastructure management, and software delivery systems.

* Demonstrated experience driving organization-wide engineering productivity, automation, and modernization programs.
  

  

**Technical Skills & Additional Experience**
--------------------------------------------

* Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP

* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible

title: DevOps Engineer – GPU / Edge AI Deployment
description:
**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Domain:** AI/ML, Edge Computing, Video Surveillance & Defence Technology

We are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to manage the packaging, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of real-time EO/IR (Electro-Optical/Infrared) vision systems across edge GPU nodes and central servers.

The role involves building reliable and repeatable deployment pipelines for containerized applications, AI inference runtimes, GPU environments, and supporting backend services within an integrated surveillance and command system.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, Linux systems, NVIDIA GPU runtimes, CUDA/TensorRT compatibility, and production release management. Experience deploying AI applications on edge devices or working in restricted-network environments will be a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for frontend applications, APIs, Python AI runtimes, and AI model/engine artifacts.
* Develop and manage Docker images for x86\_64 GPU servers and ARM64/aarch64 edge devices, including NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
* Manage Docker Compose-based deployments for services such as APIs, LiveKit/SFU, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, MinIO, and map tile services.
* Maintain compatible NVIDIA CUDA, TensorRT, GPU driver, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and JetPack runtime configurations.
* Manage staged releases across development labs, staging environments, and customer sites.
* Validate deployment health, service availability, GPU utilization, application logs, and system performance after updates.
* Implement release versioning, configuration management, model-pack promotion, and rollback procedures.
* Troubleshoot production issues involving video streams, GPU drivers, AI engine loading, disk capacity, containers, and service failures.
* Manage secrets, environment variables, credentials, ports, and site-specific configuration files securely.
* Maintain backup and recovery procedures for PostgreSQL/PostGIS databases and S3-compatible storage such as MinIO.
* Develop deployment runbooks, incident response procedures, release checklists, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate deployment schedules and maintenance windows with customer IT teams while adhering to network restrictions and access-control policies.
* Maintain reproducible deployment baselines using container image digests, model/engine checksums, and configuration manifests.
* Support resource monitoring and optimization for concurrent video streams, AI inference, tracking, mapping, and API services.

Required Skills & Technical Experience

* **Experience:** 3–7 years in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or production deployment of containerized applications.
* **Docker & Containers:** Strong experience with Docker, multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, container registries, and image versioning.
* **CI/CD:** Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or equivalent pipeline tools.
* **Linux Administration:** Experience with Linux services, systemd, shell scripting, logs, disk management, GPU monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* **NVIDIA GPU Stack:** Practical experience managing CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA drivers, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and runtime compatibility.
* **Edge Deployment:** Experience building and deploying applications for x86\_64 GPU servers and ARM64/aarch64 devices. Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson and JetPack is highly desirable.
* **Release Engineering:** Experience managing versioned application releases, AI model artifacts, engine binaries, configuration files, and rollback workflows.
* **Configuration & Security:** Knowledge of environment variables, secrets management, secure credential handling, and controlled configuration changes.
* **Storage & Databases:** Familiarity with PostgreSQL, PostGIS, S3-compatible storage, MinIO, and backup/restore procedures.
* **Monitoring & Recovery:** Ability to troubleshoot production incidents and implement reliable health checks, monitoring, and recovery processes.

Preferred Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* Experience deploying computer vision, AI inference, or video analytics applications on edge GPU hardware.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson flashing, image creation, and device provisioning.
* Experience with Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, and infrastructure automation.
* Knowledge of air-gapped deployments, offline package repositories, private registries, and low-bandwidth update strategies.
* Familiarity with LiveKit, SFU architecture, TURN networking, and real-time video streaming infrastructure.
* Experience working with defence, surveillance, industrial, or other security-sensitive systems.

Key Requirements for This Role

* Ability to reproduce production environments using versioned deployment manifests and artifact checksums.
* Strong understanding of GPU runtime compatibility and troubleshooting across development and production environments.
* Ability to execute controlled updates and recover failed deployments with minimal downtime.
* Comfort working on-site with restricted networks, customer IT teams, and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Strong ownership of production reliability, deployment quality, documentation, and incident resolution.

Interview Assessment

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* An end-to-end CI/CD pipeline they have designed, implemented, and maintained.
* A production incident they resolved and the steps taken to restore service.
* A rollback of an incompatible GPU runtime, container image, or AI model/engine release.
